project_type: Full-stack astronomy app: Spring Boot 3.3.2 backend (celestia_be) + React/Vite/three.js frontend (celestia_fe). Monorepo under app/Celestia.
build_system: Backend: Maven via ./mvnw (Spring Boot parent 3.3.2); openapi-generator-maven-plugin 7.5.0 (generatorName=spring, interfaceOnly=true) generates DTOs into org.celestia.generated.model under target/generated-sources during the generate-sources phase, so a build is REQUIRED before new DTOs resolve. Lombok 1.18.34 + MapStruct 1.5.5 annotation processors. Frontend: Vite, npm run build.
test_framework: Backend: JUnit 5 via spring-boot-starter-test; @WebMvcTest for controller slices (see AuthControllerTest, which excludes SecurityAutoConfiguration/SecurityFilterAutoConfiguration and uses MockMvc + @MockBean). Frontend: no test runner wired; verify via build only.
build_command: Backend: ./mvnw -q -DskipTests package (run from app/Celestia/celestia_be). Frontend: npm run build (run from app/Celestia/celestia_fe).
test_command: Backend: ./mvnw -q -Dtest=AstronomyServiceTest,SkyChatServiceTest,SkyChatIntegrationTest test (from app/Celestia/celestia_be). Frontend: none — never start the dev server.
verification_instructions: After backend code changes run ./mvnw -q -DskipTests package then the -Dtest=... test command; both must pass. After frontend changes run npm run build. Before finalizing, confirm git diff excludes application.properties and mvnw and contains no secret values.
snapshot_or_generated_files: DTOs are generated from src/main/resources/openapi.yaml into target/generated-sources/.../org/celestia/generated/model by the openapi-generator plugin on every build; they are NOT checked in. constellation-centers.json is generated ONCE by the Appendix script (design.md) from the frontend catalog and checked in.
environment_constraints: Work in-place in the repo (no worktree). Do NOT commit or push. Do NOT modify src/main/resources/application.properties or mvnw (already-modified, unrelated working-tree files; the groq.api-key secret must stay out of the diff). Never start the frontend dev server. Only ADD; do not change existing sky-map azimuth/coordinate/rendering code (eqVec, altAzLookTarget, horizon labels, scene builders).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md in the repo (only celestia_fe/README.md and celestia-ml/README.md). Follow existing in-repo conventions: constructor injection, @Service/@RestController, generated DTOs (never hand-rolled), ErrorMessage(status,message) record for error bodies, exceptions mapped in GlobalExceptionHandler.
key_patterns: Controllers thin, delegate to services (ConstellationController -> ConstellationService). Chat flow: service maps generated ChatMessage list into List<Map<String,String>> ({role,content}) and calls GroqService; GroqService has a private 2-arg chat(messages, systemPrompt) and a public chat(constellationName, history) wrapping it with a friendly fallback string. GlobalExceptionHandler maps exceptions to ErrorMessage with @ResponseStatus (InvalidCredentialsException -> 400 is the template for new 400 branches). SecurityConfig permits /constellations/** and /images/** anonymously, ends in anyRequest().authenticated(). Frontend chat: api.js request(path, body) POSTs JSON with credentials+auth header; useChat.js hook holds transcript; ConstellationChat.jsx is the panel (dark palette rgba(10,14,28,0.97), accent #4a90d9, lucide Sparkles/Send/X).
relevant_files: MODIFY src/main/resources/openapi.yaml (add /skymap/chat path + SkyChatRequest/SkyChatResponse/VisibilityFacts schemas; reuse ChatMessage)
ADD src/main/resources/constellation-centers.json (88 line-member centroids, generated by Appendix script)
MODIFY src/main/java/org/celestia/backend/config/ConstellationSeeder.java (load centers first; fresh-seed-with-centers if empty else back-fill nulls)
ADD src/main/java/org/celestia/backend/service/AstronomyService.java (toJD/getLST port, inverse altAz, rise solver, 4-state classifier, compass map)
MODIFY src/main/java/org/celestia/backend/service/GroqService.java (expose a public phrasing entry point)
ADD src/main/java/org/celestia/backend/service/SkyChatService.java (validation, fuzzy name resolution, orchestration, system-prompt building)
CATALOG celestia_fe/public/data/data/stars_full.json (HIP-indexed ra/dec/mag, degrees) + constellations.json (dict keyed by 88 abbrevs, each {name, lines:[[hip,hip]...]})
directory_structure: celestia_be/src/main/java/org/celestia/backend/{config,controller,dto,exception,mapper,model,repository,service}; generated DTOs resolve to org.celestia.generated.model (from openapi.yaml). celestia_be/src/main/resources/{openapi.yaml,constellations.json,application.properties}. celestia_be/src/test/java/org/celestia/backend/{config,controller,exception,service}. celestia_fe/src/features/{skymap,constellation}/{components,hooks,utils}; celestia_fe/src/services/apiClient.js; celestia_fe/public/data/data/*.json.
